the @@S:shownName@@
day 1

  • Hunt: Don't starve. Hunt prey, defeat predators and increase your kill count.
  • Survive: You will die. Life is measured in days in Bone Age — learn strategies to stay alive.
  • Explore: Every life is different. Discover the three maps and uncover secrets.
  • Light Fires: Only the fire you wake beside is burning. Thrust your spear into it to light the spear, keep the flame alive, and thrust it into cold fires to make safe camps.
